detectionNotes: The PRD declares '--brownfield --tech-stack react', and package.json confirms it: Next.js 14.2.18 App Router, React 18.3.1, TypeScript strict, Prisma 5.20.0 on PostgreSQL 16, Auth.js v5, Vitest 2.1.1 and Playwright. The MUI packages are pinned at 9.5.0 (material, icons-material, material-nextjs, x-data-grid, x-date-pickers, x-charts), with @mui/x-internals overridden to 9.1.0. PRD-11 needs no new dependencies. The MIT x-data-grid covers the gradebook grid (columnGroupingModel, processRowUpdate, virtualisation); papaparse and src/server/csv.ts cover CSV export; Prisma.Decimal and src/server/assignments/grading-math.ts cover the arithmetic; and src/server/quiz/grading.ts (applyScoringPolicy, resultsVisible, percentOf) covers quiz scores. Printing uses @media print and window.print(), so no PDF library is needed. The mui-mcp server is available for component lookup. Styling goes only through the MUI theme, sx and styled().
